title: ATR v0.3
$comment: ATR required set = lcp + terms + id; terms + id present AND non-empty (fail-fast at assemble()); lcp = the literal "0.3" (envelope format version, distinct from the LCP spec version); id = a non-empty string (low-entropy values accepted-but-flagged at the weld boundary, never kernel-graded — no strict 128-bit pattern); slot placement: governing law + liability under recourse, declarations + caps top-level, all slot values open (unknown keys preserved).

lcp.description: envelope format version, engine-stamped (distinct from the LCP spec version)

terms.description: inline agreement prose (Markdown default) OR an lcp:sha256: reference to the complete terms document — a content address to a byte-stable retained artifact, never a mutable link (TRM-2 reading below)

id.description: guaranteed-unique element, required on every record; random 128-bit recommended, low-entropy accepted-but-flagged

regime.description: Regime discriminant (CMP-2); absent = arms-length — every Plane-I function self-carried

standingTrust.description: CMP-2's explicit standing-trust references — which account, which agreement, which fingerprinted baseline; required when regime = augmented (the if/then below)

identityRoot.description: the standing account serving as identity root (IDN-6)

agreement.description: the master agreement / account terms serving as the standing terms corpus (TRM-8)

baselineHash.description: fingerprint of the standing-terms baseline document

caps.description: machine-decided bounds; keys open, value types pinned — monetary amounts are decimal-integer strings of base units, never JSON numbers; the string rule is the pattern keyword in $defs/capValue, not prose
